result.title: ActiveMedAgent: Cost-Aware Trajectory Learning for Multimodal Medical Diagnosis
result.summary: Clinical diagnosis is inherently sequential: clinicians escalate from cheap to costly tests only when additional evidence is expected to resolve diagnostic uncertainty. We present ActiveMedAgent, a framework that brings this cost-aware sequential logic to multimodal medical AI. Given a frozen, API-accessed vision-language model, ActiveMedAgent tracks probability distributions over candidate diagnoses and scores each acquisition by its per-step diagnostic utility minus cost. A lightweight MLP controller is then trained offline on these scored trajectories, learning when to request additional evidence and when to commit. Across three commonly used benchmarks, trajectory-based policy learning consistently outperforms both unguided acquisition and full-modality baselines. Notably, we identify an information overload effect. In 175 cases, the agent produces a correct diagnosis with fewer channels while the full-modality baseline fails, showing that learning what to omit can be as important as learning what to acquire.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 ActiveMedAgent，在冻结的 API 视觉语言模型上做成本感知的序列式医学诊断：追踪候选诊断概率分布，以「每步诊断效用减成本」为获取证据打分，并离线训练轻量 MLP 控制器决定何时继续取证据、何时下结论；在三个医学基准上优于无引导获取与全模态基线，并报告「信息过载」现象。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 的 LOOK/STOP 与动态计算议题直接相关，可供核查效用–成本打分如何驱动视觉证据筛选与停止决策，以及「学习省略哪些通道」对信息坍缩与视觉旁路的启示；但控制器作用于模型输出而非内部 latent 状态。
